card.title: Days in the sealed archive
card.search: The days {{first}} – {{last}} of this search are not in the database; their records are in the sealed archive. Reload them from the archive and the search covers them too.
card.clipped: One reload may ask for at most {{max}} days: the {{max}} days nearest the window ({{first}} – {{last}}) are reloaded. For older days, narrow the range.

dialog.title: Reload the days from the archive?
dialog.body: The records of {{first}} – {{last}} are loaded from the sealed archive into the database and stay there for the db.reload_keep_days setting (7 days by default); then they are removed again. This also brings the personal data of those days back into the database. The request is written to the audit log.
dialog.bodyDays_one: The records of {{first}} – {{last}} are loaded from the sealed archive into the database and stay in the database for {{count}} day; then they are removed again. This also brings the personal data of those days back into the database. The request is written to the audit log.
dialog.bodyDays_other: The records of {{first}} – {{last}} are loaded from the sealed archive into the database and stay in the database for {{count}} days; then they are removed again. This also brings the personal data of those days back into the database. The request is written to the audit log.

status.queued: Queued: starts when another reload has finished.
status.ready: The days are loaded; they stay in the database until {{expires}}.
status.expired: The reloaded days have expired and were removed from the database again.

failure.archive_day_not_in_vault: The reload failed: one of the days is no longer in the sealed archive (removed by retention while the request waited). That day cannot be reloaded.
failure.archive_file_unreadable: The reload failed: a sealed file of one of the days could not be read or does not match its seal record. Tell the administrator and run the archive verification.
